survivors.claim: Whole-suite leg first-run red on tests/render/render-capture.test.js (AC-20260905-06-1/-2) is inherited environment red, not introduced by this range; dismissal recorded per the provenance test.
survivors.impact: Two browser-launching tests go red on any machine without Chrome on the path; this spec's diff never touches them, so the recorded rerun with a Playwright Chromium is the honest green.
survivors.evidence: (1) `git merge-base --is-ancestor d70c5c9 e1835455` -> exit 0 (last commit touching the file predates the base); `git diff --name-only e1835455..HEAD | grep -c render` -> 0 (file byte-identical to base). With `CHROME_BIN=/home/jj/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome npm test` -> tests 1322 / pass 1322 / fail 0 / skipped 0. Deviations sidecar reading is correct.

killed.claim: The prune misses a git-ignored worktree copy nested below the top level (a `newdir/.claude/worktrees/...` copy survived the walk in a scratch repo, testFiles 2 instead of 1).
killed.evidence: Fixture error, not a defect: a `.gitignore` pattern containing a mid-path slash (`.claude/worktrees/`) is anchored to the .gitignore's directory, so the nested copy is NOT ignored. `git ls-files newdir` -> `newdir/.claude/worktrees/wt/tests/t.test.js` (tracked by `git add -A`); `git ls-files -o -i --exclude-standard --directory` listed only `sub/ignored/`. A genuinely ignored nested dir (`*.build/` -> `specs/x.build/`) WAS pruned: probe reported testFiles 2 with the x.build copy absent.

killed.claim: D2's subdirectory-root guard is untested (AC-3 only covers the non-repository case) and could prune the wrong subtree.
killed.evidence: Executed on a scratch repo with `.gitignore` = `sub/ignored/`: `--probe-at-risk --root <repo>/sub` -> {testFiles: 2} (unpruned, exit 0, empty stderr) vs `--root <repo>` -> {testFiles: 1}; `--root .` from the top -> pruned correctly. `env PATH=/nonexistent node ... --root <repo>` -> {testFiles: 4} unpruned, exit 0, no stderr.
